scope: tracked src/**/*.py only; no tests, archives, plugins or operational records
working_tree: current local source, including pre-existing edits
limitations: Function matching uses file and start line; class aggregates and unmatched/nested blocks require separate review.
Numeric 20/20/20 is an approximation, not Radon-equivalent scoring.
No application imports, source changes, dependency changes or gate installation.

combined_gate_observation.gate: Lizard >20 OR Ruff >20 OR cognitive >15; source-scoped, exploratory
